title: On the structure of contractively decomposable projections on noncommutative $L^p$-spaces and Schatten spaces
summary: We show that the range of a contractively decomposable projection on a noncommutative Haagerup $L^p$-space, $L^p(\mathcal{M},\varphi)$, for $1<p<\infty$, is completely isometrically isomorphic to a corner of a noncommutative $L^p$-space, that is $eL^p(\mathcal{N},ψ)(1-e)$, with $e\in\mathcal{N}$ a projection. In the setting of Schatten spaces, we obtain a more precise description: the range of a contractively decomposable projection on $S^p(K,H)$ is isometric to an $\ell^p$ direct sum of subspaces of the form $S^p(K',H')$.
